candidate_diagnostics.scope: Candidate-supplied diagnostics on the ordered first 512 validation impressions at separately trained checkpoints; 60475 valid events and 4 empty histories. Neither population estimates nor independent training-gradient audits.
candidate_diagnostics.checks: Both report zero same-state full/active product and logit differences, zero padding mass and empty summaries. Eight-mode synthetic VJPs now have reported relative-scaled errors <=3.602e-15, with 2 probes per mode, 1 synthetic boundary and 4 floored valid cases. Notes describing these measurements as unknown were prospective submission notes; committed diagnostic outcomes now exist.
candidate_diagnostics.caution: No natural floor/boundary cases in this ordered sample. Scale-sum/squared-sum conservation does not conserve summed gradient norms, Adam moments or update energy. Checkpoint correlation/distance comparisons are consequences of different training trajectories.

slice_analysis.status: All inherited 23 slice definitions and current comparisons are exploratory; no post-hoc bin fitting or independent statistical votes. Counts checked identical across trials. Original exact bin construction is not fully exported.
slice_analysis.insufficiency: Empty history has only 310 positives despite 8272 impressions; rare subgroups and ordered first-512 events cannot establish mechanism precision. No invented sufficiency threshold. User clustering, intervals and multiplicity adjustments are unavailable from aggregates.
slice_analysis.missing_coverage: Training-frequency groups are present, but full missing/unseen-field population slices are not exported; diagnostic target-brand zeros do not substitute for them. No events beyond the 128-event cap are observed.

observations.statement: Feature-only, pooled and target-aware references have AUC 0.6050036145, 0.6102261137 and 0.6133619861; both history additions reduce Logloss. This establishes local predictive value of history, without diagnosing a specific semantic limitation.
All 36 allowed attempts succeeded with null errors; previous_runtime_error is null. No unobserved execution failure is invented. Negative scientific results are retained below.

Full action-count correction loses AUC and worsens loss for pooling and DIN. A weaker half correction improves pooling but still lowers DIN AUC. This unsuccessful follow-up does not refute all multi-behavior modeling and is distinct from product-gradient scaling.

Joint removal of off-diagonal category-brand and target-context products gains 0.0011629547 AUC against the ordinary adapter; cross-product removal alone nearly attains that gain. Context removal alone improves AUC but worsens loss. The AUC interaction is subadditive. Deterministic bridges leave a small ordinary-adapter/original-DIN offset unresolved.

Aligned unit products improve over aligned raw by 0.0004876568 AUC and lower loss. Normalization gives only 0.0000139449 AUC to crossed products and worsens loss. Alignment also wins with detached denominator gradients. Product magnitude alone is insufficient as an explanation conditional on source isolation; semantic causality is unestablished.

Backward-only controls report matched same-state forward values but different learned outcomes. Projection improves AUC at unscaled, inverse-norm and constant 0.2 scales, with scale-dependent contrasts. Constant scaling nearly matches full AUC while full has lower loss; exact own-event scaling is not uniquely required for the recorded seed-42 ranking level.

Full/fixed deterministic replays exactly match AUC, Logloss and slices. Whole-history mean is numerically near full/fixed AUC with worse loss; whole-history half-rotation loses AUC and loss. Replay equality and numerical closeness are neither independent repetition nor equivalence.

Action-wise mean underperforms history mean on both metrics. Action-wise half-rotation recovers 0.0000550676 AUC relative to history half-rotation but worsens loss by 0.0001036900 and still trails full. Grouping reverses the mean-minus-half AUC sign; its difference in differences is -0.0003700171.

Action-adjacent gives AUC 0.6149537731900387 and Logloss 0.1965878918767361. Versus action half-rotation: AUC +0.00016887232285123233, loss -0.00010079459426207138. It still trails full and fixed AUC and has worse loss than both.

History-adjacent is the new numerical AUC maximum, +9.8962003826086331e-06 above the previous fixed-scale incumbent, with loss worse by 8.0971968067777844e-06. Action-adjacent minus history-adjacent AUC is -4.4968552168733744e-05. The action-minus-history adjacent-versus-half AUC interaction is -0.00010003616178433372; the corresponding loss interaction is -0.00010015059417306515.

Both latest arms exceed original DIN AUC at seed 42. History-adjacent minus DIN is +0.0016367556231391411 AUC and has lower loss; this combined lineage gain cannot all be attributed to the latest donor change.

History-adjacent wins AUC in 10/23 overlapping slices against full and loss in 4/23; action-adjacent wins 7/23 and 2/23. History-adjacent empty-history AUC is 0.5764913581 versus full 0.5839558467 (delta -0.0074644886), with loss +0.0007375294; only 310 positives are in that slice. Shared parameters can change empty-history predictions even when the local empty summary stays zero.

History-adjacent loses AUC in the >64-history slice by 0.0000208289 despite winning full-population AUC. AUC is not an additive average of slice AUCs; cross-slice positive-negative ordering also contributes. No mechanism attribution follows from this apparent aggregate/slice difference.

Latest ordered-checkpoint diagnostics report original-to-assigned centered scale correlations 0.55634 (history) and 0.50954 (action), versus half-offset comparators -0.08553 and -0.10724 at those same states. Mean absolute donor index gaps are 1.983/3.206 versus 62.392/61.133, and donor age gaps 6369.81/10255.54 seconds versus 174352.92/171055.83. The adjacent rule changes >95% of scales relative to half in the sample.

History-adjacent transports about 9.536% of sampled scales across action labels; action-adjacent transports none. Sampled scale sums and squared sums are preserved to <=1.778e-7 relative error. Action-code counts are 57171/1634/650/1020, so these diagnostics predominantly concern the common behavior.

Committed synthetic eight-mode VJP checks report errors <=3.602e-15 and zero forward discrepancies. These candidate-authored probes support bounded implementation activity/correctness, not independent attribution or population gradient/update behavior. Floor/boundary events occur synthetically but not naturally in the 512-row sample.

Both latest models and close controls have 17130275 parameters (17078688 embedding, 51587 dense). History/action adjacent wall seconds are 599.56/616.45 and train seconds 511.73/528.06; peak memory is about 835.10 MB. Relative speed differences are descriptive; no equal-compute frontier or reliable runtime advantage has been measured.

interpretations.statement: The donor reassignment rule matters locally: a nearby donor recovers the AUC lost under half-rotation in both tested groupings. The earlier half-rotation penalty does not establish that all scale reassignment is harmful.
interpretations.qualification: Two controlled local contrasts conditional on receipt-described isolation. Same seed and two deterministic donor rules only; no repeated mechanism support.

interpretations.statement: A blanket need to preserve exact own-event inverse norm is weakened by full, fixed, whole-history mean and history-adjacent AUC proximity. The full derivative retains the best observed Logloss.
interpretations.qualification: No equivalence/noninferiority margin or cross-seed precision; adaptive validation selection can dominate tiny rankings.

interpretations.statement: Preserving action membership alone does not explain recovery: action half-rotation remains below full while history-adjacent recovers AUC with nonzero cross-action donation. This is limited evidence against action preservation as the sole sufficient/necessary account for these implementations.
interpretations.qualification: Do not generalize necessity/sufficiency beyond these observed rules and seed; time/order/norm correlations remain confounded.

interpretations.statement: Temporal proximity, high own-to-donor scale correlation and scale-to-gradient-direction covariance are plausible accounts of the adjacent-versus-half contrast, but are not separated. Short donor age/index gaps and positive scale correlation co-occur; learned checkpoint statistics are downstream of optimization.
interpretations.qualification: No claim that temporal semantics, causal interest relevance or an optimal locality radius has been identified.

interpretations.statement: Grouping interacts with donor operation at seed 42, while earlier mean-versus-half interaction and negative action-mean outcomes remain valid local observations. The latest contrast revises the interpretation of reassignment, without erasing those outcomes.
interpretations.qualification: Mixed-round controlled performance contrasts; independent source verification and paired repetitions remain necessary.

interpretations.statement: The selected AUC leader has no demonstrated practical or universal advantage over fixed/full. Its loss and empty-history penalties must accompany its primary metric selection.
interpretations.qualification: Numerical selection under the frozen metric, not significance or final scientific success.

regular_event_algebra.definitions: p_j=q_category*h_category_j + q_brand*h_brand_j elementwise; u_j=p_j/||p_j||; P_j=I-u_j*u_j^T; s_j=1/||p_j||. Only regular nonfloored product-channel events are described here.

limitations: Only seed 42; deterministic replays are not independent repetitions. Adaptive validation reuse may inflate tiny selected differences; no significance, equivalence, noninferiority or repeated support is claimed.

Actual candidate sources, checkpoints, raw data and user-level predictions are unavailable. Source/config hashes and candidate notes are provenance, not independent verification of initialization, data order, checkpoint selection or backward isolation.

Two deterministic donor offsets are tested, not independent random permutations. Donor time/index gap, original-to-assigned scale correlation and gradient-direction covariance change together; temporal or semantic causality is unidentified.

Scale-moment conservation does not match aggregate gradient norms, Adam states or update energy. Mean replacements additionally remove variance. New offset contrasts hold projection fixed and do not identify projection-by-donor interactions.

The candidate-supplied ordered first-512 diagnostics have 4 empty histories and no natural floor/boundary events. Two synthetic probes per mode do not verify all training states, device/dtype behavior or actual optimizer updates.

All 23 overlapping slices are exploratory. Empty-history has 310 positives; user-cluster intervals and precision are unavailable. Missing/unseen-field full-population metrics and history beyond 128 events are unobserved.
AUC/Logloss disagreement alone does not diagnose calibration, and full-population AUC is not the weighted mean of slice AUCs. Empty-history changes may reflect shared learned parameters.

The ordinary adapter versus original-DIN offset persists despite same-seed bridges; do not treat the ordinary bridge as an exact numerical reproduction. Published DIN differs from this softmax-based local adaptation.
Static user/ad snapshot dates are undocumented. Host data/causal/scorer readiness is inherited, not independently rerun, and supplies no production point-in-time guarantee.

Equal parameters/data passes do not establish equal compute. No allocated GPU time, exact examples processed, repeated latency estimate, equal-compute frontier or actual closed-assessment cost is exported.

All 36 exposed trials succeeded operationally. Scientific negatives and abandoned count/crossed/identity/mean branches remain recorded; unseen failures or disabled personal knowledge are not invented.

Closest normalization/surrogate-gradient literature is unverified; bounded empty registry search is not a novelty result. Industry card relevance is declared provenance only, with no adoption, component test or causal knowledge-value estimate.

Only analysis.json is authorized in this phase. Reproducible aggregate analysis is delivered, but executable training commands, source artifacts, checkpoint verification and final suite freeze require a later authorized interface.
